- **12-16:** 6 + A damage; A < AVERAGE, [bleeding](scc:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/bleeding) (save ends)
- **17+:** 10 + A damage; A < STRONG, [bleeding](scc:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/bleeding) (save ends)
